# Synapse

> A shared context layer that captures AI coding sessions and surfaces insights across projects.

Synapse gives AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) persistent memory across sessions through structured insights and automatic session capture.

## API
- Base URL: https://api.synapsesync.app
- Auth: Bearer token (API key or JWT)
- MCP endpoint: https://api.synapsesync.app/mcp

## Key endpoints
- POST /auth/login - Authenticate, get API key
- POST /auth/signup - Create account
- GET /api/projects - List projects
- POST /api/insights - Save an insight (decision, learning, preference, architecture, action_item)
- GET /api/insights?project_id= - List insights for a project
- GET /api/conversations?project_id= - List captured AI sessions
- GET /api/context/:project/search?q= - Search historical files (semantic + full-text + keyword)

## MCP Server
npm package: synapsesync-mcp
Install: npm install -g synapsesync-mcp && synapsesync-mcp wizard

Agents save new knowledge via `save_insight`. Reads for historical filesystem browsing are available too.

## Tiers
- Free: 50 files, 3 connections, 3 version history, 2 team members, insights included
- Plus ($5.99/mo): 500 files, unlimited connections, full history, unlimited members, AI-generated project context

## Documentation
- API docs: https://synapsesync.app/docs.md
- OpenAPI spec: https://synapsesync.app/openapi.json
- Agent card: https://synapsesync.app/.well-known/agent.json
